from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # The most frequent/background color becomes 1; the sparse foreground becomes 0.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[1 if v == background else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
